M-601: VAV BOX SCHEDULE VAV-1..VAV-17 (AHU-1) and VAV-19..VAV-29 (RTU-2), 28 boxes (no VAV-18); EXPANSION & BUFFER TANK SCHEDULE EXT-1, EXT-2 (expansion) and CBT-1 (chilled water buffer); AIR DEVICE SCHEDULE S1..S8, R1..R4 and RH-1 (a relief air hood, counted with the air devices it is scheduled with).
